claims: Setup now fails completely when `origin` isn't on GitHub — `scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-setup.sh:556-557`: the two new probes run with no GitHub-origin check, `gh repo view` (`:179`) fails, and `set -e` stops setup with a generic gh error
Even if that call passed, the write probe would push a branch to the non-GitHub remote and then print a GitHub-specific error

The pre-push hook runs during the write probe — `:206`: `.trunk/trunk.yaml:130-141` runs `agent-quality-gate.sh --run` on every pre-push, which bites when setup is re-run on a checkout that already has `core.hooksPath`

The delete push at `:217` also runs the hook; if the gate fails there, `created=false` has already been set, so the cleanup trap never retries, the probe branch is left behind on origin, and the error message wrongly blames the token

Chromium isn't refreshed during cached maintenance — `scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-maintenance.sh:101`: if a task branch bumps Playwright in the lockfile, maintenance installs the new package but never downloads the matching browser, leaving setup and maintenance inconsistent
The pull-request API checks prove almost nothing — `:177-186`: a token with pull-request read but not write passes, then fails later at `gh pr create`
The commit subject overclaims what the pull-request API checks verify
If the repo is public, both GET requests succeed for any valid token, which `gh auth status` already checked, so the step adds nothing beyond confirming the repo name resolves (unconfirmed)

The probe branch may trigger a Vercel preview build — `:206` (suspected): `ui-dashboard/vercel.json` evaluates every pushed branch and `vercel-ignore-build.sh:~272` builds when the branch differs from main in dashboard paths
The error message at `:134` still asks for "repo/read PR permissions" while the runbook now requires Contents and pull-request read/write
No tests cover `verify_github_api_capabilities`, a failed delete, or a non-GitHub origin
The write-probe tests mock `git`, so they check the command order but not how the real push behaves
A branch ruleset restricting branch creation would also trigger the "read-only token" error

judge_reasoning.3846756487: Review item 4 says the PR API checks only prove read access: a token with PR read but not write passes and then fails later at gh pr create.
judge_reasoning.3846756810: Review item 1 says the new probes lack the non-GitHub-origin guard that verify_origin_git_auth has (:158-161), so gh repo view and the push break with CODEX_CLOUD_ORIGIN_URL.
judge_reasoning.3846756918: Review item 2 says that when the delete push fails, created=false has already been set, so the cleanup trap never retries and the probe branch is left on origin.
judge_reasoning.3846756922: The review never raises collisions in the probe branch name from the timestamp/$$ scheme.
judge_reasoning.3846757143: Review item 5 flags a Vercel preview build triggered by the pushed branch, but treats the branch creation itself as acceptable and never proposes avoiding the mutation (e.g. --dry-run).

1.why: Setup runs verify_github_api_capabilities at :556, which calls gh repo view at :179 with no host check, while verify_origin_git_auth (:158-161) skips non-GitHub origins. This is the known :179 defect.

2.why: verify_origin_write_access also has no GitHub-origin guard and prints a GitHub/Contents-specific message. Same root cause as the known :179 missing-origin-check defect.

3.why: The probe runs `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/...` without --no-verify. .trunk/hooks/pre-push hands off to trunk, and trunk.yaml:130-141 then runs agent-quality-gate.sh --run on pre-push. If core.hooksPath is already set (setup only sets it later, at :563), the gate runs and can fail the probe.

4.why: The code sets created=false before `return 1` after the delete push fails, so the EXIT trap never retries. This restates the known :242/:243 defect about keeping the cleanup fallback.

5.why: codex-cloud-maintenance.sh:101 only runs pnpm install. The new install_playwright_host_dependencies exists only in setup, so a branch that bumps @playwright/test (^1.60.0 in ui-dashboard) gets no matching Chromium in cached containers.

6.why: The probe only sends GET repos/X and GET repos/X/pulls, which proves PR read access, not write. This is the known :195 defect.

7.why: An opinion about the commit subject wording ('verify Codex Cloud shipping capabilities'). No code defect beyond the known PR-write gap.

8.why: Says the GET-only API checks add little. This elaborates the known :195 defect that only read access is probed.

9.why: vercel.json's ignoreCommand builds non-main branches that differ from main in dashboard paths, so the probe push could trigger a preview. This is a consequence of the known :231 defect that the probe mutates origin on every run.

10.why: Line 133 still says 'repo/read PR permissions', but the updated runbook now requires Contents read/write and pull-request read/write. The error message and the docs now disagree.

11.why: The test file adds only playwright, write-access success, and push-refused cases. Nothing exercises verify_github_api_capabilities, a failing delete push (which would expose the created=false bug), or a non-GitHub origin.

12.why: Stubbing git in a unit test is standard practice. The claim names no concrete defect in the tests.

13.why: Depends on hypothetical repo rulesets that can't be verified. The push's stderr isn't redirected (only stdout goes to /dev/null), so GitHub's real rejection reason is still shown.
